subject: REVIEW C2 (7dd7442+4462135): 2 ranked TLS/WLS hardware risks, no draw-v3/ABI blocker
body:
Probes in gpu/build/claude-audit-20261025: tlswls_probe.c (includes the real bridge n2c_prepare_local/n2c_local_pack, compares every LOCAL_STORAGE against Mesa MALI_LOCAL_STORAGE_pack from nord2_mesa_pack.h), abi_probe2.c.
VERIFIED: LOCAL_STORAGE bytes IDENTICAL to Mesa pan_emit_tls arch9 for 8 tls/wls/core-mask cases (tls shift=ceil_log2(ceil(sz/16)), PACKED mode, ptr>>8 48-bit, wls scale=log2(pow2(max(sz,128)))+1, core_id_range = last set bit of shader_present); BOs 16K-aligned >= Mesa 4K; ABI 488 C==Rust (swizzle_valid@160 level_offset@168 row@296 slice@360 layer@424); planes region 17248+32*23*32 <= 40960; mip/layer wire bounded by n2t_layout_check against declared span and BO; TGP1 + TLS is refused at compile (parse_v1 needs w12/w13==0); expandIndex leak and non-JM sampler refusal fixed; draw v3 FAU +64/+68 == TEGU_GRAPHICS_VERTEX_BASE/BASE_INSTANCE, fau_words are 32-bit words so >=17/>=18 is right, first_provoking_vertex only when FS uses flat, lines refused.
RISK 1 (GPU fault, bridge.c n2c_prepare_local): TLS BO = pow2(align16(tls))*512*core_id_range. 512 is Mesa's panfrost fallback for arch9 when the kernel reports nothing; pan_query_thread_tls_alloc uses THREAD_TLS_ALLOC ?: THREAD_MAX_THREADS (pan_props.c:54). nord2_gpu_status does not export N2HW_THREAD_MAX_THREADS (read at nord2_gpu_hw.c:98). If the G77 reports 768, a private-memory kernel on high thread ids runs past the BO (guarded VA) -> MMU fault -> bridge sets broken=1 and refuses all later dispatches. Fix: export the register (append to status) and size with it, or refuse TLS until known; first hardware test with tls_size>0 should be tiny and last.
RISK 2 (availability, same function): WLS instances = min(pow2(grid), cores*512) and total multiplied by cores again; Mesa uses per-core pow2(wg_per_task*max_tasks). Probe: wls 4096 B, local 256, grid 4096, 9 cores -> 151 MB (Mesa ~0.15 MB); 32 KiB wls, grid 65536 -> 1.36 GB. nord2_gpu_allocation_size caps a context at 64 MiB wired in total (transport.h:99), shared with all textures/buffers, and each BO is bzeroed in kernel. Result is BAD refusal or starving the UI process for most threadgroup-memory kernels, not a fault. Fix: instances per core = pow2(ceil(512/threads_per_wg))*2.
LOW: WLS 4 GiB rule is a post-allocation refusal depending on VA placement (retry/alignment); cap is not a power of two for odd core counts (comment wrong, floor_log2 keeps it in bounds); render now compiles EVERY generic pipeline through the options entry (DRAW_PARAMETERS|EXTENDED_VARYINGS, render_pipeline.inc:219): ask corpus for a byte/FAU/preload/varying-layout diff of the C1-qualified UI shaders against the legacy entry before packaging; Rust mip span uses pixel rows and level-0 stride, so compressed mip chains over-refuse (safe).
